Yağız Ekrem Dalar

Communications Lead, AI & Data Engineer

An AI researcher and project builder working across computer vision, reinforcement learning, Turkish NLP, multimodal systems, and scientific computing.

Profile

From experiments to dependable systems.

Yağız leads communications at Ethosoft while contributing as a data engineer and AI researcher. His work spans research prototypes, institutional collaborations, and the reproducibility layers that help teams inspect and extend them.

The supplied CV describes a broad practice in computer vision, reinforcement learning, Turkish NLP, multimodal systems, LLM agents, scientific computing, medical AI, and privacy-aware infrastructure. He works across the full path from experiment design and training to data pipelines, evaluation, and public communication.

Research

Selected research directions

  • Mycelium — revision and analysis work on counterfactual dependability in language-model safety mechanisms.
  • UGTC — a reinforcement-learning study described in the CV as a multi-backbone, multi-suite, ten-seed draft with ablations.
  • ForesightLM and NEDOTURKISHTOKENIZER — language-model and Turkish-tokenization work spanning representation learning, data quality, and evaluation.
  • SPF-Seg, TR-DocVQA-Synth, and CAST-FL — applied research directions in medical segmentation, document understanding, and federated intrusion detection.
  • Contextual amnesia and agent systems — draft work on visual-language segmentation and context-compiled tool-using agents.

Applied work

BIDIK
